name: Quartermaster
effect: One extra point of weapon capacity. Must already be equipped.

name: Frontiersman
effect: Extra uses for limited-use tools. Solo with Catalyst grants two extra uses.

name: Catalyst
effect: With Frontiersman, playing solo grants two extra tool uses instead of one.

name: Doctor
effect: First Aid Kit restores 100 health per use instead of 50.

name: Physician
effect: Bandage faster with the First Aid Kit.

name: Fanning
effect: Faster hip fire with compatible single-action revolvers.

name: Levering
effect: Faster hip fire with lever-action weapons.

name: Bulletgrubber
effect: Recover live rounds when partially reloading compatible weapons.

name: Bolt Thrower
effect: Faster reloads for compatible crossbows and bomb weapons.

name: Hundred Hands
effect: Improve the Hunting Bow at full draw and use arrows for melee.

name: Martialist
effect: Unlock the Katana's stronger sheathed opening strike.

name: Fast Fingers
effect: Faster reloads for compatible single-shot rifles.

name: Iron Eye
effect: Stay in iron sights while cycling compatible weapons.

name: Scopesmith
effect: Stay in scope view after a shot.

name: Steady Aim
effect: Reduce sway while using scopes or aperture sights.

name: Assailant
effect: Stronger melee attacks with Throwing Knives and Throwing Axes; not the Spear.

name: Pitcher
effect: Longer throws for items with a throwing aim guide.

name: Packmule
effect: An extra item when looting Hunters or Tool Boxes. Adds no loadout slots.

name: Decoy Supply
effect: Replenish decoys at ammo crates.

name: Poacher
effect: Place and disarm traps quietly; does not affect Dark Dynamite Satchels.

name: Silent Killer
effect: Quieter melee attacks.

name: Blade Seer
effect: Spot recoverable projectiles and throwing tools at greater range.

name: Blademancer
effect: Retrieve compatible recoverable ammo through Dark Sight.
